ground_truth.body: The `_untouch` method violates LRU cache policy by appending freed blocks to the end of `free_block_queue`, making them least likely to be reused immediately. During memory pressure (when allocation fails), these blocks should be prioritized for reuse as they represent the least recently used candidates and must be added to the front of the queue.
